name: Hard Choice
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Young woman → remove skirt, earrings, handbag, heels, socks to reduce weight.
Elderly woman → remove coat, cash pouch, thermos, gold chain, prosthetic/brace flask gear.
Man → remove gold watch from wrist.
Result → all heavy items removed so they become light enough to pull up safely.
